tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa kun dga' blo gros dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser sbags sgrub ku se dpon ngag dbang dge legs la chu yos zla 4 tshes 18 la// oṃ swasti/ dkon mchog la skyabs smon 'jug sems bskyed bsgom/ /tshad med bzhi ldan chos kun stong par sbyangs/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar 'jam mgon kun blo'i mtshan/ /pad zlar gyur pa'i rje btsun 'jam dbyangs ni/ /zhal phyag rgyan sogs yongs rdzogs thugs ka ru/ /gser 'khor rtsibs bzhi'i lte ba'i g.yas su dhīḥ g.yon la rtsibs bzhir ra dang pa tsa na/ /de las 'od 'phros bdag gzhan mun pa sbyangs/ /rang gi lce steng dhīḥyig nyal thabs la/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i ljags kyi dhīḥyig 'phros/ /ngag gi sgrib sbyangs shes bya rab 'byams shes/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par gyur/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes ci nus dang / dbugs thang gcig la dhī brgya rtsa sogs bzlas la/ 'jam mgon bla ma 'od phung dmar ser zhu/ /rang gi spyi bo nas thim sgo gsum 'dres/ /ka dag gdod ma'i ye shes thugs kyi dbyings/ /kha dog lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /gang du'ang 'char bar tshad med sprul pa che/ /nga sogs sems can kun gyis myur thob shog /gti mug mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma shar/ /byams dang snying rje 'byongs pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /byin rlabs char 'bebs dngos grub sprin phung gis/ /'phral yun dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/ //ces pa 'di sa skya pa kun blor/ ku se ngag dbang dge legs kyis/ /bskul don bzhin du gang thon bris/ /mkhas rnams thugs khrel mi gnang zhu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ bla ma dam pa kun dga' blo gros dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser sbags sgrub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
